call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: typography refinement of the supplied single Korean online recruitment poster, portrait 2:3.
Input image: the sole referenced image is the exact edit target. Edit that image only.
Primary request: improve the invitation-to-application-to-logistics reading hierarchy and integrate the type with the diagonal pickup action. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Preserve the photograph: keep the existing framing, canvas orientation, continuous sandy shore, shallow water/pebbles, two cropped knit-gloved hands, trigger grip, single metal shaft, connected black jaws gripping the dirty clear crushed bottle, open translucent teal collection bag, visible bottle-to-opening relationship, rim grip, bag folds, shadow, daylight, color and scale. The bottle and all contacts must stay in the same places. Do not reshoot, redraw, stylize, move, enlarge, replace or simplify any photographic subject. Preserve photographic pixels as closely as the editing tool permits; changes are confined to the existing typography and its necessary sand-background cleanup. Do not add photograph details or change crop/perspective.

Typography changes:
Use one coherent deep-navy Korean sans-serif family with a genuine hierarchy of weights rather than uniform heavy bold. Keep legible dark-on-light contrast throughout.
- Keep the exact title as a three-line unit at its current left-side invitation area, preserving the source's meaningful breaks after the comma and after 줍는. Reduce its overall width and size by approximately ten percent, tighten its interline spacing modestly, and set the round and flat letter shapes to one carefully judged optical left edge. Its upper/right silhouette should fit naturally into the negative triangle below the diagonal shaft and beside the bottle/bag opening, with generous clearance from those objects. Retain strong title character without making three identical oversized slabs. Do not spread the word spaces or distort Korean strokes.
- Place the exact recruitment line close beneath the compact title in a medium weight, smaller than the title and slightly less insistent than in the source.
- Make the COMPLETE application sentence the clear next reading immediately after this invitation. Keep the existing word-boundary wrap after its colon and put the entire URL on one line. Increase both the deadline line and URL to substantial semibold type, approximately 40–42px-equivalent at a 1024px-wide canvas. Their typographic emphasis must clearly exceed the subsequent schedule: the deadline and URL must be found before date/time/place. Give this plain text block comfortable space above and below. No banner, box, badge, button, colored field, arrow or decorative rule.
- Reduce the date, time and meeting-point block from its oversized heavy source treatment to a coherent medium weight, approximately 31–33px-equivalent at a 1024px-wide canvas. Preserve readable numerals and all words; keep these three related items together with consistent baseline rhythm. Its size and weight must be subordinate to the complete application block.
- Use a coherent regular body weight for eligibility, supplied equipment, personal preparation, weather and cost/certificate policies. Keep their size at least as comfortable as the existing smaller policy text, approximately 30–32px-equivalent at a 1024px-wide canvas. Do not make them tiny, faint or cramped. Give semantic groups deliberate whitespace: eligibility/provision/preparation form one group; weather/cost/certificate form another. The contact remains a separate readable regular-to-medium line.
Use clean line rhythm, consistent left optical alignment, generous line gaps and meaning-based grouping while respecting the bag silhouette. This is a continuous photographic plane with type in the usable negative sand areas, not a full-width top heading, hero panel and footer. Use the space gained from the compact title/schedule to improve hierarchy and breathing room. At a 720px-wide view every long condition and the complete URL must remain comfortable to read. No type may overlap the tool, hands, bottle or bag. Do not solve hierarchy by shrinking required conditions.

Exact complete artwork copy. Each of these twelve items appears once, preserving every word space, punctuation mark, numeral, date and URL. The order may be title/recruitment/application/appointment/conditions/contact as requested above. Wrap only at existing word boundaries; never split or alter the URL. The quotation delimiters are not printed:
“우리 바다, 함께 줍는 토요일”
“하람 해변 정화 참여자 모집”
“2026년 11월 21일 토요일”
“오전 9시 30분 집결 · 낮 12시 종료”
“하람시 물결마당 앞 · 파도길 8”
“대상: 만 14세 이상 누구나 · 선착순 40명”
“집게와 수거 봉투는 제공됩니다.”
“개인 장갑, 마실 물, 모자를 준비해 주세요.”
“우천 시 취소되며 신청자에게 전날 문자로 안내합니다.”
“참가비 무료 · 봉사 확인서는 발급하지 않습니다.”
“11월 18일까지 신청: haram-wave.example/join”
“문의: 바다정화 운영팀”

Constraints: one flat edge-to-edge portrait 2:3 poster. Keep the photo subject, original materials, color, daylight and contact structure unchanged. All twelve exact copy items once, with stable Korean strokes and word spacing. No invented copy, extra group headers, decorative marks, icons, logo, numbering, watermark, QR code, frame, boxes, banners, arrows or new effects. No collages or mockups. Do not change the photograph to accommodate the text. Refine only typographic proportion, weight, optical alignment, grouping, line spacing and the plain early registration emphasis.

unintended_changes: Photographic microdetail regenerated: bottle creases/dirt, bag film folds/highlights/translucency/interior contents, glove and sandy shore texture. No major subject/composition/contact change observed.
residuals: Body is lighter but some lines retain a medium-weight appearance.
Lower copy remains a mostly conventional left-aligned sequence.
Photo is not pixel-identical to input; exact preservation not achieved.
Exact jaw pressure and cropped rim-hand anatomy remain partly obscured.
Small copy is not fully readable at 213px thumbnail.
